title: Better-funded rivals, 150x for Setpoint and unknown for Cascade

rows.label: Cascade Debt
rows.detail: Public aggregators conflate several unrelated companies named Cascade.

caption: Cascade Debt's row is empty on purpose. A bar at zero would say 'raised nothing'; the truth is 'not disclosed', and the public aggregators that show a number for it are mixing it up with other companies.
source: Setpoint Series B release, August 13, 2024; ycombinator.com/deal, accessed September 20, 2026.
